pmc/german_desc: The missions for this Faction are focused on completing activities and eliminating enemy AI.

super_mp/br_balloon_extract_desc: Mobile Loot Deposit For Your Team
super_mp/br_plunder_extract_desc: Mobile cash deposit device for your team.
hash_6b2229869f1bb80c: The Automated Computer Spike slowly captures points and temporarily hacks nearby enemy devices.
hash_3c647b4ff730229c: Disables communication with intel within its radius. Enemies will not be able to activate killstreaks. Enemy UAV and intel systems will not detect you and your teammates. Location of the scrambler is visible in the enemy minimap.
super_mp/ddos_desc: Activates a device that deactivates electronics, and disrupts enemy sensors in the immediate area for a short time.
hash_4b5e3c8fa799f5ef: Temporarily makes your footsteps silent and applies Ghost. Gun, melee, and throwing knife kills refresh duration.
hash_48b28e5cf5283588: Activate a large electrical blase around the player.
hash_4b16dd4e95a1ee84: EVGs highlight and outline combatants assisting in target acquisition and identification.
hash_2c1caee30d14e970: Levitate and fire laser vision that will melt your adversaries.
hash_1554c5ea48623dad: Revive yourself while in last stand.
super_mp/loadout_drop_desc: Call in a team based loadout crate with limited uses. Each player can only use it once.
hash_302e819be9f5b79c: Deploy a box of medical supplies for you and your teammates.
super_mp/oxygen_tank_desc: An oxygen tank that allows you to breathe underwater.
super_mp/personal_redeploy_drone_desc: Portable Redeploy Drone that will carry you to new heights
super_mp/personal_redeploy_drone_insuffi: Not enough space to use Drone
super_mp/recon_drone_desc: Remote-controlled drone that has manual and auto marking capabilities.
super_mp/reinforcement_flare_desc: Flare gun that brings a dead squadmate back.
super_mp/smoke_airdrop_desc: Call in a line of drones to deploy a smoke wall at a targeted location.
super_mp/sonar_pulse_desc: Emits a periodic radar ping to detect nearby enemies.
super_mp/sound_veil_desc: Trip mine that when triggered, emits a constant sound wave that disrupts enemy vision and slows their movement.
super_mp/tac_insert_desc: Marks a location as your next spawn point.

super_zm/energy_mine_desc: Spawn an explosive, dealing massive damage to enemies who set it off.
super_zm/frenzied_guard_desc: Force all enemies in the area to target the Player for 10 seconds. Armor completely mitigates damage while active. Repair armor to full.
super_zm/frost_blast_desc: Damage enemies with the initial blast and slow those that enter.
super_zm/tesla_storm_desc: For 10 seconds lightning connects to other players, stunning and damaging normal enemies.

Mantle faster. ADS while sliding and diving. Take less fall damage.
Slayer Playstyle.
